content:
carla: Quick heads-up - doing a focused pass on model card updates for the catalog PRs. Goal: sanity-check supported models, per-model limits, benchmark rows, and compatibility notes. Also fix broken links and update SDK snippets. I'll open a checklist in the docs repo.

alice: Thanks - which model cards are highest priority? I saw AuroraX, orion-mini, and zephyr-mini on the backlog.

carla: Primarily AuroraX and orion-mini variants. AuroraX currently lists a 16k token limit by mistake; our perf runs show stable results up to ~12k. Need to change limits + add a "long sequences" caveat. Also add note about quantized CPU fallbacks.

ben: I can handle SDK examples (py/js). Want both the minimal sync snippet and a streaming example? Any preferred snippet style?

carla: Yes both. Use the new compact pattern: auth (1 line), client init (1 line), request (1 line). For streaming show `for chunk in resp.stream():` style. Keep output examples short. Example to mirror: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${{REPO_SECRET}}")
resp = client.generate(model="aurorax-7b", input="Summarize the PR")
print(resp.output)
```

ben: Got it - I'll also update the JS snippet to use `client.chat.stream()` and include a small comment about checking `model.capabilities` for streaming support.

david: I ran microbenchmarks for AuroraX on p4d yesterday. Observed token/s: 2300 @512, 1900 @1024, 1200 @4096, ~400 @12288. Memory looked fine but throughput drops after ~8k due to KV pressure. We should reflect that in the benchmark table and add an "expected degradation" row.

carla: Thanks - can you paste the exact numbers and the test command you used so I can add them to the card?

david: Sure: ```bash
# loadgen: 1 stream, batch 1, seq_len variable
python bench.py --model aurorax-7b --instance p4d --batch 1 --seq 512 1024 4096 12288
# results (tokens/sec): 512:2300, 1024:1900, 4096:1200, 12288:400
# note: config: fp16, kv-cache enabled, kernel=auto
```

carla: Perfect. I'll add those numbers to the benchmarks table and mark the 16k token limit down to 12k with a short note: "12k recommended; performance degrades past 8k - see bench numbers." Also add a compatibility line: "requires CUDA 12.2+ and driver 535+ for best perf".

alice: Do we need to update the model catalog compatibility matrix as well, or will a badge/link in the card suffice?

carla: Both. Add the badge that points to runtime-compat, and I'll update the matrix row for aurorax in a separate PR. Keep this PR scoped to docs edits + snippets + link fixes.

ben: One more question - there are existing snippets referencing `client.text.generate` in old cards. Should I replace those with the unified `client.generate` alias?

carla: Yes, prefer `client.generate` (canonical). Add a tiny migration note: "Old `client.text.generate` is still supported but deprecated - use `client.generate`."

docs-bot: Branch created: `docs/aurorax-compat-1958007654`. PR skeleton opened: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/3412 - includes checklist: [x] limits update, [ ] benchmark table, [ ] sdk snippets, [ ] link fixes, [ ] compatibility badge.

ben: I'll take sdk snippets and the link fixes. Assign to me.

carla: Assigned. @david could you add the bench CSV to the PR comment so it's easy to copy to the table?

david: Done - attached CSV in PR comment.

alice: I'll proofread the text changes and run a quick lint pass for broken anchors/links. Also will check anchor names for the new compatibility badge.

carla: Awesome. Timeline: aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. If anyone runs into blocker-level doc diffs (like changing limits that affect API samples) ping me in this thread.

ben: will do. starting work now. :hammer_and_wrench: 

alice: quick note - found one stale link to the old quantization guide: `https://docs.redwood/quant-old` - will replace with `/optimize/quant` in the PR.

carla: Thanks. Add the replacement in the PR description so release notes capture it.

docs-bot: Reminder set: channel=docs, time=24h, message="Follow up on aurorax card PR".

carla: Great - marking this thread as the coordination thread for the PR. Ping here for updates. :white_check_mark:
